provenance.limitation: Historical runner checked timed samples but did not check the diagnostic checksum. Allocation counters remain historical context, not a verified diagnostic baseline.

limitations: Local Mac measurements are not comparable to Linux CI timings.
GC bytes with TLAB enabled count region capacity, printed to 0.1 MiB; not exact logical object bytes.
No-TLAB controls alter allocator/collector behavior and are not timing comparisons.
Static O3 dumps do not establish which optimized bodies executed in hybrid.
Historical CI did not validate the instrumented checksum. Future CI uses the new gate.
Allocation figures cover the Ash GC domain, not all native/compiler allocation. RSS is separate.
Local hybrid timed samples had 16.5% relative standard deviation and a bimodal split; do not use them as evidence of a speed improvement.

allocation_reconciliation.conclusion: The approximately 2.67 MiB source-to-O3 difference is consistent with scalarizing one positive-item root per inner iteration and the stretch/long-lived roots. Normal no-TLAB execution reports 900.0 MiB; disabling AIR inlining reports 902.7 MiB. Default TLAB accounting reports 900.1 MiB. Region capacity, other runtime allocations, dynamic tier coverage, and rounding prevent an exact per-object interpretation of the residual.
